description: Engineering Conversation Packet (ECP) 1.0 — the vendor-neutral handoff format for Part 8 conversation import (docs/product/18_ENGINEERING_CONVERSATION_POLICY.md). Documentation reference only, matching Part 4's schemas/ convention (not enforced by a schema library — see scripts/product-docs/automation/conversation/ecp.js's hand-rolled validateEcp()). Unknown fields beyond this shape are preserved but never trusted as fact.

ecp_version.description: Must be "1.0" for this schema revision.

source_tool.description: Metadata only, as claimed by the packet — never a trust signal. See policy § 13.

source_conversation_id.description: Opaque external ID, if the source tool provides one — used for exact-duplicate detection on re-import.

revisions.description: Each item: {trigger?, user_feedback?, prior_approach?, revised_approach?, reason?, status?}

bugs_discussed.description: Each item: {symptoms?, hypotheses?, evidence?, root_cause?, proposed_fixes?, accepted_fix?, rejected_fixes?}

implementation_requests.description: Each item: {request?, expected_feature_ids?, expected_roadmap_ids?, constraints?, expected_tests?, non_goals?}

integrity.description: Filled by the importer at import time (fingerprint/checksum), not by the source tool.
